examples.name: Sample — a subpoena caption
paragraphs: Under a centred court heading, a ruled box of three cells: two blank party lines with vs between them on the left; CASE NUMBER over a blank line and the three-line title SUBPOENA / FOR / DEPOSITION in the centre; an empty File Stamp Here box on the right. The cells are taken left to right, each as one block of lines. On this page SUBPOENA FOR DEPOSITION is the document's own title, so it is rendered as the document heading, its three printed lines joined. The page header line above is elided.

examples.name: Sample — a § divider
paragraphs: A bold CAUSE NO. line with its blank above the caption; blank party lines with PLAINTIFF, v. and DEFENDANT on the left, a column of seven § on the divider, and the court, the precinct (with its blank) and the county on the right. The § column is dropped; the left block comes before the right.
